title: MinosEval: Distinguishing Factoid and Non-Factoid for Tailored Open-Ended QA Evaluation with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting a comparative analysis of the average response length between human manual annotations and LLM-predicted rankings at different ranking positions to evaluate if the model unfairly favors longer responses.

Conducting comparative experiments by swapping the reference answer and the model response as the premise and hypothesis in the Natural Language Inference (NLI) task to evaluate and eliminate asymmetric entailment probabilities.
